intro: The Pendant of Shadow is a dark talisman worn by the renegade warlock Morganth atop the Tower of Ilgalar in the Redridge Mountains. Brought to the mage Theocritus at the Tower of Azora, it serves as undeniable proof that the rogue spellcaster has been eliminated before his sinister ambitions could bear fruit.

p: Held by the rogue warlock Morganth within his perch at the Tower of Ilgalar, the Pendant of Shadow is steeped in dark sorcery. Morganth sought to unravel the mysteries of the Scythe of Elune, an ancient relic of immense and volatile power. Fearing the havoc the warlock could unleash upon the Redridge Mountains and the kingdom of Stormwind, the mage Theocritus tasked adventurers with infiltrating Ilgalar, ending Morganth's plotting, and wresting the talisman from his grasp as proof of his demise.
